description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kendaliyaddapaluwa, Matara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510835 (23/0395)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 0299, 0298, and 0019) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and title classification. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
